purpose: Define when a measured difference is entitled to support an interpretation. Every representation must declare which invariant it is expected to preserve, distort, or destroy before measurements are interpreted.
origin_lineage: Alan Parsons Project external VERIFY THE WORLD: controlled musical/production contrasts became interpretable relative to stable reference frames.
Robert Miles Children SHA-256 experiment: the post-hoc 97254 LCS observation generated a prospective hypothesis and failed to replicate as LCS>=5 in 5/5 new related pairs.
Robert Miles decoded-audio witness: musically related versions remained measurably close in chroma while SHA-256 avalanche erased readable musical proximity.
The combined result establishes a representation-sensitive measurement law rather than a music-specific claim.

objects.X1_X2: two witnesses, versions, states, observations, or systems being compared
objects.I: the invariant or property about which an inference is intended

formal_model.law: delta_R(X1,X2) is interpretable with respect to invariant I only if R preserves sufficient information about I.
formal_model.preservation_case: I(X1) ~= I(X2) AND R preserves I -> R(X1) is expected to remain measurably close to R(X2) on an I-relevant metric.
formal_model.destruction_case: I(X1) ~= I(X2) does not imply R(X1) ~= R(X2) when R deliberately destroys or decorrelates I.
formal_model.representation_nonidentity: NO_REPRESENTATION_IS_THE_WORLD; EACH REPRESENTATION PRESERVES SOME INVARIANTS AND DESTROYS OR DISTORTS OTHERS.

preserves: exact byte identity witness through equality/non-equality of digest under the same hash function
valid_metrics: bit Hamming statistics under an explicitly frozen null
invalid_inference_examples: musically similar tracks should have visually similar SHA256
visible digest substring implies musical code

preserves: time-domain audio waveform up to the chosen decode/resample contract
pitch-class / harmonic distribution to the extent captured by the extraction method
valid_metrics: harmonic-family proximity under frozen extraction and metric rules

preserves: declared concepts, relations, roles, or symbolic abstractions
branches.risk: semantic maps can manufacture apparent coherence if the mapping contract is changed after observation

required_contract_fields_for_any_future_.representation_name: What transformation or measurement channel is being applied?
required_contract_fields_for_any_future_.target_invariant_I: What property is the conclusion actually about?
required_contract_fields_for_any_future_.must_preserve: Which features must survive for the intended conclusion to be meaningful?
required_contract_fields_for_any_future_.may_distort: Which features may change without invalidating the conclusion?
required_contract_fields_for_any_future_.must_destroy_or_ignore: Which nuisance features should be removed, randomized, or explicitly ignored?
required_contract_fields_for_any_future_.metric: What frozen statistic measures the relevant relation after R?
required_contract_fields_for_any_future_.reference_frame: Relative to what baseline, comparator, calibration, or control is delta_R interpreted?
required_contract_fields_for_any_future_.positive_control: What known-related case should R successfully recognize?
required_contract_fields_for_any_future_.negative_control: What unrelated or null case should R not confuse with the target relation?
required_contract_fields_for_any_future_.falsifier: What result would invalidate the interpretation or show that R is not preserving I adequately?
required_contract_fields_for_any_future_.multiplicity_rule: How are multiple metrics, thresholds, windows, transformations, and exploratory branches controlled?
required_contract_fields_for_any_future_.provenance_rule: What exact input bytes/source/version produced the representation?
required_contract_fields_for_any_future_.unknown_rule: OPEN/NULL/BLOCKED outcomes must remain explicit rather than filled by intuition.

difference_has_interpretive_rights_if: the representation contract existed before interpretation or is explicitly labeled exploratory
the representation is relevant to the target invariant
the metric is defined on information the representation actually preserves
the reference frame and controls are adequate to distinguish signal from nuisance
the result survives the frozen falsifier/multiplicity rules
difference_has_no_interpretive_rights_if: the representation destroys the target invariant
the metric measures an unrelated property
the representation/metric was selected after seeing the desired pattern without post-hoc labeling
controls cannot falsify the preferred story
a null or failed replication is discarded

calibration_example_robert_miles.post_hoc_observation: Children Dream vs Original shared shifted SHA256 substring 97254 of length 5.
calibration_example_robert_miles.prospective_result: LCS>=5: RELATED 0/5; CONTROL 0/5. The post-hoc pattern did not replicate.
calibration_example_robert_miles.sha_secondary_hint: Fixed-position hex matches related mean 6.0 vs control 3.4; raw descriptive exact permutation p=0.03968; simple four-SHA-metric Bonferroni sensitivity ~0.159; HINT NOT DISCOVERY.
calibration_example_robert_miles.audio_positive_control: Related versions preserved substantially higher chroma similarity than disjoint same-catalog controls in the frozen small-N audio witness.
calibration_example_robert_miles.lesson: The representation decides which relationship remains visible.

calibration_example_app.representation_contract_extension: The reference frame is legitimate only when it preserves the feature about which the conclusion is made.
calibration_example_app.lesson: Controlled contrast is interpretable only inside a representation that retains the relevant invariant.

canonical_seal: A DIFFERENCE EARNS MEANING ONLY AFTER THE REPRESENTATION DECLARES WHAT IT PRESERVES. PRESERVE THE INVARIANT, FREEZE THE METRIC, NAME THE REFERENCE FRAME, AND GIVE THE CONTROL POWER TO SAY NO.
